channel.title: Pixelburg Sport
channel.description: Fictional sample sport stories for offline demos and tests. Not real news: the outlet, the clubs, the players, the competitions, the results and the quotes are invented.

item.title: Pixelburg United beat Bitport Athletic 3-1 to go top of the Pixel League
item.description: Pixelburg United beat Bitport Athletic 3-1 at the Riverside Ground to go top of the Pixel League for the first time since 2009. Goals from Kip Halvorsen, Sami Okonjo and substitute Dario Pellucci sealed the win after Bitport had levelled before half-time. United are now two points clear of Starfield City at the top of the table. Manager Ines Marlowe said: "The players earned every point today, and we will enjoy it tonight."

item.title: Bitport manager Okafor apologises to fans after defeat at Pixelburg
item.description: Bitport Athletic manager Amara Okafor has apologised to the club's travelling fans after their 3-1 defeat at Pixelburg United. It was Bitport's third defeat in four league games. "We let them down in the second half, and that is on me," Okafor said. Bitport Athletic host Copperfold Town on Saturday.

item.title: Late Lindqvist goal earns Starfield City a draw with Ledgerton Rovers
item.description: Starfield City drew 2-2 with Ledgerton Rovers after Rafe Lindqvist scored in the last minute. Rovers had led twice through goals from striker Teo Vance. City stay second in the Pixel League, two points behind Pixelburg United.

item.title: Quaywick Albion thrash Copperfold Town as Haddad scores hat-trick
item.description: Quaywick Albion thrashed Copperfold Town 5-0, with striker Noor Haddad scoring a hat-trick. It is Albion's biggest league win in 30 years. Copperfold have now lost five league games in a row and sit bottom of the table.

item.title: Glimmerford edge past Lanternhill to reach Harbour Cup quarter-finals
item.description: Glimmerford beat Lanternhill 1-0 to reach the quarter-finals of the Harbour Cup. Mira Castell scored the only goal from a free-kick ten minutes from time. The quarter-final draw will take place on Monday.

item.title: Saltmarsh Sirens beat Kestrel Vale Women to reach the Coastal Cup final
item.description: Saltmarsh Sirens beat Kestrel Vale Women 31-12 to reach the final of the Coastal Cup, with captain Hana Petrov scoring two tries. A crowd of 6,000 watched the semi-final at the Saltmarsh Bowl. Saltmarsh Sirens will face Harbourside Hawks Women in the final on 1 November.

item.title: Harbourside Hawks beat Millbrook Foxes to stay unbeaten
item.description: Harbourside Hawks beat Millbrook Foxes 24-17 in the Coastal Premiership, with two tries from winger Ade Mensah. The Hawks are unbeaten in six games and lead the table by four points. Harbourside Hawks will face Ironvale Giants on Friday.

item.title: Ana Vela wins the Pixelburg Open for her first tour title
item.description: Ana Vela won the Pixelburg Open, beating top seed Lia Moreau 6-4 6-3 in the final. It is the 22-year-old's first title on the tour. Vela said she would celebrate with her family and then start preparing for the indoor season.

item.title: Menon century puts Coastlanders on course for victory over Ironvale
item.description: Opener Ravi Menon made 141, his first century of the season, as the Coastlanders took control of their Harbour Shield match against Ironvale. Ironvale ended the third day on 188 for six, still 112 runs behind. The Coastlanders need four more wickets on the final day to win the match.

item.title: Zara Quist breaks championship record in the 400 metres
item.description: Zara Quist broke the championship record in the 400 metres at the Bitport Games, finishing in 49.8 seconds. The 19-year-old took almost half a second off the old mark, set in 1998. Quist will run in the relay final on Sunday.

item.title: Ironvale's oldest player heads the first goal of his career
item.description: Ironvale goalkeeper Bram Oduya, 41, scored a stoppage-time header to earn his side a draw with Millbrook. It was the first goal of his 22-year career. "I just closed my eyes and jumped," Oduya said.

item.title: Starfield City captain Amberley ruled out for six weeks
item.description: Starfield City captain Joel Amberley will miss six weeks with a hamstring injury picked up in the draw with Ledgerton Rovers. Amberley has played every league game this season. Starfield City face Glimmerford on Wednesday.

item.title: Bitport Comets beat Harbourside Herons for seventh win in eight
item.description: Bitport Comets beat Harbourside Herons 98-91, with guard Theo Ansah scoring 31 points. The Comets have won seven of their first eight games. Bitport Comets host Lanternhill Lynx on Thursday.

item.title: Mateo Ruiz wins mountain stage to take the lead of the Coastal Tour
item.description: Mateo Ruiz won the fifth stage of the Coastal Tour, a 160-kilometre ride into the hills above Glimmerford. He now leads the race by 42 seconds with three stages left. The tour finishes in Pixelburg on Sunday.

item.title: Pixelburg United and Quaywick Albion meet with top spot at stake
item.description: Pixelburg United will host Quaywick Albion at the Riverside Ground on Saturday. Albion are three points behind United in the table. Tickets for the match sold out within an hour.

item.title: Ironvale Giants head coach Petra Lind steps down
item.description: Ironvale Giants head coach Petra Lind has stepped down after four seasons in charge. Assistant coach Owen Hale will take charge for the match against Harbourside Hawks. The club said it would name a permanent replacement next month.

item.title: Northgate County win at Saltmarsh as Brightwater are held
item.description: Northgate County beat Saltmarsh 3-2 in the Pixel League Two, with Ivo Brandt scoring twice. Elsewhere, Brightwater Wanderers drew 0-0 with Kestrel Vale, and Millbrook beat Ashcombe 2-1. Northgate County are now fourth.
